sourceTitle: Emerald Martini from Las Casitas Village, A Waldorf Astoria Resort
sourceText:
Emerald Martini from Las Casitas Village, A Waldorf Astoria Resort
By: Liz Eads
Published: Thursday, March 9, 2017 - 7:35am

Ingredients




1 oz. Grey Goose Le Citron Vodka
1/2 oz. Apple pucker
1/2 oz. St. Germain
2 oz. Fresh lemonade
3-5 Mint leaves
1 Scoop honeydew
1 Pineapple slice
1 Cherry

Preparation

1 Muddle two mint leaves and honeydew. Add in St. Germain, vodka, apple pucker, lemonade, ice, and shake unitl icy cold and strain into chilled martini glass. Garnish with pineapple slice, cherry and floating mint leaf.

About

Overlooking the green treetops of the El Yunque Rainforest, Las Casitas Village wishes all a vibrant and flavorful St. Patrick's Day celebration with its Emerald Martini treat.
